setups.reaction_setup: 58Fe(alpha,n gamma)61Ni reaction at alpha energies 7.8, 11.0, and 13.0 MeV. Target at 7.8 MeV: 1 mg/cm2, 71% enriched 58Fe on thick Au backing; targets at 11.0 and 13.0 MeV: 760 ug/cm2, 87% enriched 58Fe self-supporting.
setups.angular_definition: Linear polarization measured at 90 deg; angular distribution measured at multiple angles with escape-suppressed Ge(Li) spectrometer normalized to external singles monitor (full angle list not tabulated in text; a2, a4 corrected for solid-angle attenuation).
setups.angles: P at 90 deg; multi-angle AD; exact complete angle list not tabulated in the inspected methods.
setups.gate: Singles angular distribution in escape-suppressed spectrometer normalized to external singles monitor in polarimeter scatterer; separate gamma-gamma coincidence at 8.0, 8.5, 12.0 MeV with two Ge(Li) detectors at 90 deg used for level decay scheme.
setups.polarization_calibration: Three-Ge(Li) Compton polarimeter at 90 deg to beam axis; calibration and polarization sensitivity Q referenced to Butler et al. (1973) NIM 108, 497.
setups.curve_evaluation: Joint sum of squared residuals combining compound-nucleus alignment predictions, angular distribution coefficients (a2, a4), and linear polarization P(90) minimized simultaneously over delta and alignment parameters (beta, x).
setups.final_alignment_condition: δ 与取向参数联合最小化；复合核模型预测参与残差约束。未采用一个固定 σ/I。
setups.alignment_details: p.36：以复合核统计模型估计取向，将取向参数、角分布与线偏振残差共同最小化，变量含 δ 及布居参数 β、x。不是假定单一 σ/I。原印布居公式有记号歧义，本表不擅自修正式子。
setups.uncertainty_model: δ 误差引用 James et al. (1974) 方法；本篇未明确置信水平。0.1% 是自旋假设拒绝准则，不是 δ 区间水平。
setups.locator: p. 36, Section 2; Table 3, pp. 40-41; Table 4, p. 42

setups.reaction_setup: 100Mo(40Ar, 1p4n)135Pr at 152 MeV, self-supporting 0.5 mg/cm^2 enriched 100Mo target, JUROGAM II array (24 EUROGAM clovers + 15 EUROGAM Phase 1 tapered Ge detectors)
setups.angular_definition: Rac = I_gamma(157.6 deg + 133.6 deg, gated on all angles) / I_gamma(ca. 90 deg [75.5 deg + 104.5 deg], gated on all angles). Extracted from two gamma-gamma matrices: Phase 1 tapered detectors at (157.6, 133.6 deg) vs all detectors, and Clover detectors around 90 deg (75.5, 104.5 deg) vs all detectors. Same gate on all-detector axis.
setups.gate: Same all-detector-axis coincidence gates. For polarization:747 uses450 gate;813 uses796 gate;450 uses747 gate. See Supplement pp.1,4.
setups.polarization_calibration: P=Ap/Q(E); a(E)=0.9844(21)+2(1)e-5 E(keV). Q(E) adopted from A. Herzan et al., PRC92,044310(2015), Supplement Ref.[6]; not Starosta1999. Clovers75.5/104.5 deg.
setups.curve_evaluation: Calculated response curves of P as a function of Rac for several sigma/I values in P-Rac plane for each delta
setups.final_alignment_condition: 中心值联合求解 δ 与 σ/I，区间通过响应曲线扫描传播观测误差；非单值预设，非概率边缘化。
setups.alignment_details: Supplement p.4：实验 P 和 Rac 中心值最佳匹配同时给出 δ 与 σ/I；再改变 σ/I，沿 P、Rac 实验误差边界确定 δ 上下限。这里的 FREE_JOINT 指中心值联合求解，未证明作者使用了特定二维优化算法；区间步骤另见说明。
setups.delta_convention: E2/M1 as reported; exact cross-paper phase/sign conversion not established in this pilot.
setups.uncertainty_model: 原文表列非对称误差；通过 P/Rac 误差边界传播。完整协方差与统一置信水平未给出。
setups.locator: PLB 824 (2022) 136840 p. 2-3, Fig. 2, Table 1; Supp Mat p. 1, 4, Table 1

setups.reaction_setup: 123Sb(16O,4n)135Pr,80 MeV. AD:ATLAS Gammasphere,634 ug/cm2 Sb +15 ug/cm2 Al. Polarimetry:separate TIFR-BARC INGA run,630 ug/cm2 Sb between15 ug/cm2 Al and20 mg/cm2 Au (p.2).
setups.angular_definition: Angular distributions from Gammasphere, fitted with function cited as Yamazaki1967 (p.3); numerical a2/a4 not tabulated. Not a measured two-angle ratio.
setups.angles: Gammasphere multi-angle AD (Fig.2); exact ring list not supplied in the inspected text. INGA asymmetry from separate experiment.
setups.polarization_calibration: Fig.3 reports (a*N_perp-N_parallel)/(a*N_perp+N_parallel), i.e. geometrical asymmetry correction a is included. Table I lists asymmetry, not sensitivity-corrected P. Q(E) not supplied here; details referred to Ref.[24].
setups.curve_evaluation: Angular-distribution fit and comparison curves (Fig.2). Numerical sigma/I and whether it was held fixed are not stated in this PRL.
setups.final_alignment_condition: Not reported in PRL text or Table I; fitting was performed using Gammasphere data without specifying fixed sigma/I value or prior distribution in the paper.
setups.alignment_details: PRL 114, 082501 (2015) p. 3 states angular distributions were fitted with the function given in Yamazaki (1967), but does not report the numerical value of sigma/I, whether sigma/I was fixed or varied, or alignment parameters.
setups.delta_convention: E2/M1 as reported; precise phase convention/normalization not independently reconciled.
setups.uncertainty_model: Symmetric errors as printed in Table I; exact interval construction/confidence not stated in inspected text.

setups.reaction_setup: 175Lu(18O,6n)187Au at 108 MeV, two self-supported natural Lu targets (0.7 mg/cm2 each), array of 8 segmented clover HPGe detectors at 90 deg and 16 coaxial HPGe detectors at 26, 51, 129, 154 deg relative to beam
setups.angular_definition: Two-point angular correlation ratio Rac = I_gamma(154 deg) / I_gamma(90 deg) normalized by detector efficiencies at these two angles, gated on transitions observed in all detectors
setups.gate: For 376 keV: sum of 7 cleanest coincidence gates (316, 319, 400, 417, 471, 565, 625 keV). For 462 keV: gated on 316 and 400 keV, with lower/clean gate on left part of 316 keV (313 keV) to avoid 463/465 keV contamination.
setups.polarization_calibration: A = (a*N_perp - N_par)/(a*N_perp + N_par), a(E_gamma) = 0.975(24) + 7.6(379)e-6 * E_gamma (keV) calibrated with 152Eu, 133Ba, 60Co. P = A/Q using sensitivity Q curve from Zheng et al. PRC 87, 044328 (2013) for same clover type.
setups.alignment_details: Main p.3 and Supplement pp.3-4：逐 σ/I 绘制条件曲线，将所有穿过实验误差矩形的允许解综合为 δ 范围。图示0.2/0.3等不是报告的扫描上下限；完整数值扫描域未公开。
setups.delta_convention: E2/M1 as reported; exact phase convention and conversion between sources not established.
setups.uncertainty_model: Experimental (Rac, P) rectangular uncertainty box combining statistical and 5% systematic detector error, mapped to delta envelope over unrestricted sigma/I scan.
setups.curve_evaluation: Yes: fixed-sigma/I conditional P-Rac curves, repeated across different sigma/I values.
setups.final_alignment_condition: All allowed curves through experimental uncertainty box; authors explicitly state sigma/I not restricted. No single final fixed value; no probability marginalization specified.

setups.reaction_setup: 174Yb(19F,6n)187Au at 105 MeV (57 Compton-suppressed Ge) and 115 MeV (73 Ge), enriched 174Yb target (13 mg/cm2 with 33 mg/cm2 208Pb backing), Gammasphere in triple-coincidence mode (1.08e9 events)
setups.angular_definition: Full angular distributions measured and fitted (p.3, Fig.3), not a two-angle ratio; numerical A2/A4 not tabulated.
setups.angles: 17 Gammasphere angular rings mentioned (p.3); exact complete angle list not given. Fig.3 shows angular distributions; do not infer a two-angle ratio.
setups.gate: Coincidence gated matrices and cubes (details stated in text to be provided in Ref. [26])
setups.polarization_calibration: NA: no linear-polarization result reported for this experiment.
setups.alignment_details: PRL 2020 p. 3 states: "Further details, including a discussion of the various factors that might affect the extraction of final results—efficiency corrections, spin alignment, attenuation coefficients etc.—will be provided in Ref. [26]". Numeric sigma/I and attenuation treatment were not reported in S20 PRL text.
setups.delta_convention: E2/M1 for Delta I=1 links as reported; stretched-E2 controls carry a separate unresolved higher-multipole interpretation.
setups.uncertainty_model: Fit errors quoted on delta and E2 percentage in Fig. 3(a)-(h)
setups.curve_evaluation: Angular-distribution fits; no documented numerical sigma/I or fixed/free choice in this paper.
setups.final_alignment_condition: UNREPORTED. Alignment and attenuation details deferred to Ref.[26]. This cannot be counted as confirmed fixed sigma/I.

findings: Pilot is bounded to5 papers and3 nuclei; not a prevalence estimate of commonly.
W77 Table3 originals+0.18(.05),-2.46(.15),-.02(.03) have opposite sign to submitted benchmarks; conversion unresolved.
G22 uses conditional curves and merges allowed ranges over alignment; final delta is not conditioned on one assumed sigma.
L22 jointly obtains central delta and sigma from P/Rac, then scans response to propagate errors.
W77 fits population parameters jointly with delta using model-estimated alignment constraints; no single fixed sigma/I.
M15/S20 do not report numerical sigma/I handling in the inspected primary papers; unreported is not confirmed fixed.
missing: W77: per-state beta/x values, full covariance and precise delta confidence level are not supplied in the inspected text.
W77: Q/calibration details referred to Butler1973; no original polarimeter counts in this paper.
M15/S20: numeric sigma/I and fixed/free handling unreported in inspected PRLs; referred methods/forthcoming papers require separate follow-up.
L22: 755.1-keV transition has Rac but no numerical delta or P.
G22: P/Rac points shown graphically without precise numerical tabulation; complete alignment scan range not numerically specified.
S20: exact detector-ring angle list and A2/A4 numbers unavailable in inspected text; no linear-polarization results.
Cross-paper phase conversion remains unverified; higher-multipole control definitions are marked inferred.
audit_corrections: Removed unsupported exact scan bounds0.2-0.4 from G22; illustrative curves do not define domain.
Removed invented S20 19-angle list conflicting with stated17 rings; full angular distribution is not AD_RATIO.
Corrected L22 polarization sensitivity source to Herzan2015 SupplementRef6.
Separated L22 central joint solution from interval scan; G22 retained as SCAN_COMBINE.
Classified both all-detector-gated Rac schemes conservatively as GATED_RATIO_OTHER; retained actual definitions without asserting exact W-ratio equivalence.
Removed unsupported Rose-Brink/Krane-Steffen equivalence and bare matrix-element formulas from modern papers.
W77 confidence0.1% applies to spin rejection, not delta errors; removed unverified1sigma label.
W77 P row alignment queried then confirmed by rotated table:816.7=-.12(.07),1131.9=-.03(.04),1064.6=.16(.08); retained after verification.
Preserved observable uncertainties in P/Ap/ratio columns; removed irrelevant lifetime prose.
Distinguished plotted-only G22 P/Rac from supplied PADO transcriptions.
Used actual publication version descriptions rather than worker-output version numbers.
Marked inferred higher-multipole definitions and retained two no-numerical-delta rows.
